note: Closed set of motion patterns observed in the source; each pins its reduced-motion fallback (also pinned in schema/semantic_validate.py MOTION_FALLBACK). Global rule: every animation/transition collapses to ~0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

rise-in-on-load.description: Opener lines rise 12px and fade in on load, 700ms, staggered 60/160/260/360/460ms.

reveal-on-scroll.description: Blocks fade and rise (14-26px) once when they enter the viewport (IntersectionObserver threshold 0.12-0.18).

scroll-console.description: A sticky status console tracks which step article sits in the middle 10% of the viewport.

scroll-pinned-panels.description: A pinned storyboard; scroll position advances panels and captions.

scroll-stepper.description: A pinned stepper; scroll or step buttons advance a counter, dots and messages.

ambient-drift.description: Decorative clouds drift horizontally (65-120s linear loops) and stars twinkle.

interactive-canvas-field.description: Canvas tick-mark field rotates toward the pointer; reveal brush under the name.

box-open.description: The 3D project box opens its lid when it approaches the viewport.

card-flip.description: Cards flip on tap to show a second face.

autoplay-loop-video.description: Muted looping product videos autoplay; reduced motion keeps the poster.

sticky-chapter-nav.description: Sticky chapter nav highlights the chapter in view.
